fact_definitions.meaning: The assessed actor is an intermediary distributing SFC-authorised funds in the activity under assessment.
fact_definitions.name: is_fund_distributor

fact_definitions.meaning: The assessed actor offers the identified benefit to a client; acceptance or payment is not required for this fact.
fact_definitions.name: benefit_offered_to_client

fact_definitions.meaning: The identified benefit is offered in promoting a specific fund or particular fund type, including a sufficient link to certain fund types or funds offered by certain fund houses.
fact_definitions.name: has_product_promotion_connection

fact_definitions.meaning: The identified benefit qualifies as a gift for the selected paragraph 3.11 control, before applying its fee-or-charge discount exception; guaranteed returns or incentives are not automatically classified as gifts.
fact_definitions.name: benefit_is_gift

fact_definitions.meaning: The identified benefit qualifies as a discount of fees or charges within the express exception; a cash-benefit label alone does not resolve this classification.
fact_definitions.name: benefit_is_fee_or_charge_discount

instructions:
Reconstruct the following controlled-English rule using the supplied grammar. Preserve exact fact definitions and source_unit_ids. Do not infer a legal interpretation. Report ambiguity. Formal expressions use parenthesized prefix notation, never Java or Python:
true, false, a declared fact name; (integer 6), (money_hkd 100), (date 2024-11-30);
(and EXPR EXPR ...), (or EXPR EXPR ...), (not EXPR), (if CONDITION THEN ELSE),
(= LEFT RIGHT), (> LEFT RIGHT), (>= LEFT RIGHT), (+ LEFT RIGHT), (- LEFT RIGHT).
Dates are Gregorian YYYY-MM-DD, numeric literals are exact integer strings.
Use the same type on both sides of a comparison. Unknown facts remain unknown.
scope is Boolean; result has result_type. Never invent a fact's truth value.
Use null formalization if a requirement cannot be represented in this fragment.
Every declared fact needs a meaningful definition, units, source refs and an
explicit indication of whether supplying it requires professional judgment.
